headline: The price of the butane cylinder rises to €19.55, a record: how it affects your household
summary: The price of a butane cylinder in Spain rises 3.5% to a record €19.55, valid until mid-January. The increase changes household gas spending.
why: Butane cylinders are a common household energy source in Spain, and their regulated price feeds directly into consumer energy costs and inflation. Changes are closely watched by policymakers and households.
